question: Why OpenHOI3 gave the 181. Infanterie-Division its way into 1750 an hour early.

addresses.name: RunCountryHourlyPass
addresses.comment:
**The per-country hourly pass, and the only place `CUnit` slot 31 is ever dispatched.** One caller in the whole image: `RunHourlyPass` at `0x682833`, in a serial loop over the country vector `CCurrentGameState +0xBBC` gated on `CCountry +0x44`. So everything here runs on the **tick thread**, once per game hour, before any TBB fan-out.

Per node of `country->units` (`+0xBAC`; a node is `{unit, ?, next}`):

    unit->slot31()                                CUnit::CheckOrderAndCombat, at 0x4D8F7D
    if (unit->+0x40 == 0 && unit->slot15())
        CGameState::RemoveUnit(state)(unit, 0, 1)  0x4D8FB5 - synchronous, this thread
    else if (no provinces, no government in exile, owner is not "REB")
        CGameState::RemoveUnit(state)(unit, 0, 1)  0x4D8FFD
    else
        push unit onto *survivors                  0x4D9004-0x4D904F

`RunHourlyPass` then hands that same vector to `SpawnProcessUnitParallelFor` at `0x682887`, and `ProcessUnitFunctor`'s serial body calls `CUnit::UpdateHourly` per element at `0x68ECC9`. **So slot 31 runs on the tick thread over every unit, and `UpdateHourly` runs on workers over the survivors.**

After the unit loop: `0x508C30(country)`; then an hour gate, `hour == country->id % 24`, feeding `0x8AC400(country + 0x48C, matched)` - or `0x8A9B10(country + 0x48C, 0)` when `CCountry +0x580` is set; then `0x4E0B80(country)` when the owned-province count is positive; then `country->+0x11CC = 0`. `ret 4`, `this` in ECX, ends at `0x4D9165`. **The order of `country->units`, read 2026-11-15** (FINDINGS-liveread.md, section 95): after a load it is the save's unit tree walked children first, units made since appended at the end - Germany's 253 loaded units in exactly that order at 21:00 on 16 July 1941. So which unit's CheckOrderAndCombat comes first in an hour is that order: the 181. Infanterie-Division (31st) checks its support attack on 1750 before the 81., 57. and 11. (99th, 120th, 46th) start the battle there, and gets its way an hour later.
addresses.evidence: Germany's list walked on the running game at tick 60807885, each node's unit serial (+0x14) set beside the save's tree order: 253 of 253 in order.
